response.justification: The candidate is a strong generalist engineer with broad experience across web, mobile, and systems programming, but does not meet the role's core requirements. Professional C++ experience is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years, and there is no evidence of Windows-platform C++ work, SQL Server/Oracle experience, or fixed-income/capital-markets domain knowledge beyond a brief fintech role at RIDE Capital that focused on Node/TypeScript.
strengths: Strong low-latency and systems programming background (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput microservices)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development
Broad polyglot experience with SQL, Java, scripting, and DevOps tooling
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, ending in 2015 — far below the 5–10 year requirement
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets/investment-banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development experience
